_howToUpdate: Add new log entries to the TOP of 'log'. Add methods, audits, code, reports, and publications to the matching 'items' list under 'resources'. Only link to things that really exist. Run 'npm run check' before publishing. README.md has examples.

log.title: Fuller second model added
log.summary: A second model chose among 10 setups using only training studies, with calibration, age adjustment, and a fairer model comparison. Its accuracy was similar to the first run. It was designed after first-run results were seen, so it isn't independent validation. The first run's model comparison was also corrected.

log.title: First exploratory analysis completed
log.summary: Public processed profiles were analyzed under a recorded plan, and preliminary results were posted. They have not had advisor or peer review, and labels are still being checked against the original papers.

log.title: Planned main analysis updated
log.summary: The planned main analysis is now a comparison across multiple conditions, with Crohn's disease as a descriptive pilot. No microbiome profiles have been downloaded, and no experiments or validation have been carried out.

log.title: Research question updated; protocol development continues
log.summary: The research question now covers false alerts for people with Crohn's disease and other conditions, and the plan includes an open-source benchmark. No microbiome profiles have been downloaded, and no experiments or validation have been carried out.

log.title: Research question defined; protocol development underway
log.summary: The research question for this project has been defined and protocol development is underway. No experiments, dataset downloads, or validation have been carried out yet.
